name: Oti Mabuse
about: In this two-part episode, Marius Iepure sits down with his wife Oti Mabuse, two-time Strictly Come Dancing champion, who grew up dancing in South Africa, walked away from a civil engineering degree and crossed continents to build her career in Germany and the UK. In part one she opens up about what Germany taught her, the realities girls face in DanceSport, protecting her daughter from the industry, and why African dance carries a spirituality that ballroom often forgets.

In part two they talk about every one of her Strictly partners, from Anthony and Danny Mac to back-to-back wins with Kelvin Fletcher and Bill Bailey, learning that you cannot work alone on the show, doing Strictly through lockdown, and why she left with nothing left to give and wanted a family life. Plus Dancing with the Stars in Ireland, rapid fire questions, Scotland in the World Atlas, building the OMDS studio, where the power sits between DanceSport and TV, and where competitive DanceSport is heading.
teaser: Oti Mabuse on her Strictly partners, two wins in a row and why she walked away at the top.
